headline: Subsidies for Chinese EVs expand… domestic production tax credit legislation golden time [Chinese offensive shakes home market]
summary: Imported EVs can also receive state subsidies if they meet performance and price requirements. Nineteen ruling and opposition lawmakers jointly sponsored legislation on a domestic production tax credit.
why: Subsidy and tax-credit policy shapes the competitive balance between imported and domestically produced electric vehicles, affecting automakers and battery suppliers.
